entities.name: Makan Traoré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Makan Traoré is a French boxer. He competed at the 2023 European Games, winning the bronze medal in the men's light middleweight. He also competed at the 2024 Summer Olympics in the men's 71 kg event, but was defeated in the round-of-16 by Nikolai Terteryan.
